description: H9 synthetic twins (#84): references qualified by another specification (SPEC-<n> or a hyphen-joined namespace), each with a twin of the opposite outcome. Constructed before the H9 candidate from the frozen policy; not independent labels. The 10 rule-2 (not-adopted) cases frozen at 5cd81e7 were removed when rule 2 was reverted (owner decision, 2026-11-25).
